frequency_question: What proportion of major labor union federation strike notices successfully complete all procedural steps and reach an initiated strike within the statutory time window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide strike calls by recognized federations requiring compulsory conciliation and strike ballot periods; excludes wildcat strikes or single-plant actions without statutory notice requirements.
provenance_note: 7 cases named, 8 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.1x)
coverage_note: 7 named major instances in the sector; 1 instance where a notice was withdrawn prior to the deadline due to conciliation settlement.
known_gaps: Minor local or regional single-bank warning strikes omitted as they do not match the national federation indefinite strike threshold.
skeleton: Total major federation-backed strike calls in the sector that completed procedural requirements versus those called off or lapsed during notice periods.
multiplier: 7 hits out of 8 total initiated formal notices in the observed structured sample.
validity_reason: Labor dispute statutes and basic conciliation timelines under industrial relations laws remain stable over medium-term horizons.
